projectDescription: A cross-platform C# library and CLI toolkit implementing Windows network protocols including SMB2, MSRPC, LDAP, NTLM, and Kerberos for security research, penetration testing, and system administration.
keyFeatures: SMB2/3 client with signing, encryption, DFS, and filesystem control code support
MSRPC over TCP/IP with DCOM, WMI, LSA, SAM, SCM, EFS, and Remote Registry interfaces
Kerberos authentication with PKINIT, S4U2self/S4U2proxy, ticket management, and ccache/kirbi support
NTLM and SPNEGO authentication with pass-the-hash support
LDAP client with SSL, channel binding, and Active Directory extensions
Extensible CLI framework with uniform authentication parameters across all tools
publicApiSurface: Kerb CLI — Kerberos ticket management and AS/TGS requests
Smb2Client CLI — SMB2 file system operations
Wmi CLI — WMI query and execution
Lsa CLI — LSA policy and privilege management
Sam CLI — Security Accounts Manager enumeration
Scm CLI — Service Control Manager operations
Ldap CLI — LDAP queries against Active Directory
Reg CLI — Remote Registry with backup semantics and SAM dump
Dcom CLI — DCOM remote automation object activation
Sddl CLI — SDDL descriptor parsing and description
